title: code edge persistence model and storage evidence chunk 1
summary: AST code edges (calls/imports) persist as a SEPARATE overlay.code_edges array, never the task `edges` array, so they stay out of the DAG scheduler, dup judge, and spreading-activation traversal (mirrors how code_nodes is its own map). Edge shape: { from_file, to (code_node key code:<file>#<name>) | to_file, kind:'calls'|'imports', name?, ambiguous? }. Resolver (lib/code-extract/resolve-edges.js, pure/deterministic): call edge from=file,to=callee-name resolves to ALL repo code_nodes defining that name (ambiguous:true when >1; no local def => dropped, counted external); local import edge fans to the imported file's EXPORTED symbols, falling back to a single file-level edge (to_file) when the imported file has no exports; external imports dropped. `from` stays the FILE because the extractor attributes calls only file-granularly. Persistence: graph-store events code_edge_added/code_edge_removed keyed on a synthetic codeedge:<from_file> container node (stripped from graph.nodes on load via __codeEdgeContainer), projected into loadGraph().codeEdges and rehydrated into overlay.code_edges — survives daemon reload incl. per-file removals (prev-state diff in emitDiff, same mechanism as code_
